title: Level 1.1 - "Corrupted Corridor"
survival_class: Varied Safety . Unsecured . Varied Entity Count .
physical_identity: A long straight narrow corridor inside Level 1: white-painted cinder block walls, blue tile floor, exposed pipes and ducts, crates of supplies. Degrades through five sectors from stable to glitched.
scale_topology: Single corridor, unknown length; Sector 1 ~10-15 mi, Sector 2 est. 5-50 mi; four confirmed sectors plus unconfirmed Sector 5; indoor.
anomalies: Sector 2 slanted floors, colour shifts, repeating hallway sections
Wall noclip into Level 1 in Sectors 2-3
Sector 3 unsourced patches of bright light
Sector 4 undulation, no collision, void below
lighting_sound: Fluorescent hum in Sector 1; Sector 3 mostly dark regardless of lights or flashlights, random bright patches; Outpost 2 lights on 16 h / off 8 h timer.

entities.name: Smilers
entities.behavior: Occasional in Sector 2, common in Sector 3

entities.name: Skin-Stealers
entities.behavior: Occasional in Sector 2; mutated in Sector 4

entities.name: Sector 4 floating glitched entities
entities.behavior: Float freely, mutated; survivors say they hovered without attacking (TESTIMONY)

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers, Hounds, Skin-Stealers (Sector 2-3), floating glitched mutated entities (Sector 4); none documented in Sector 1
hazards: Sector 4 vertigo, nausea, no collision, void
items_communities: Tunnel Gang (leader Blade, 6 members) at Jakob's Hut

entrances.method: Travel due south of M.E.G. Base Alpha to signed entrance
entrances.quote: traveling due south of M.E.G. Base Alpha in Level 1

exits.quote: escaped by backtracking through the corridor and exiting through the entrance
Noclipping can also land explorers in a random part of Level 1
Noclipping through the level drops one into a presumably endless void.

signature_mechanic: One corridor whose stability degrades sector by sector: supplies thin out, darkness and slope grow, Sector 4 loses collision. Noclip becomes more likely deeper but Sector 4 noclip is void-only.
verticality: Slopes and drops in Sector 2; wobble and void in Sector 4; otherwise flat.
conflicts_notes: Page flagged outdated. Link list includes Level 1.2 and Level 0 with no exit statement. Interview mentions Levels 2 and 4 only in anecdote.

no documented dangerous entities in this sector
overhead lighting or flashlights do not appear to change this state
